Q1: B

RATIONALE:
Q1: The pipeline can only change repository files and open one pull request. It cannot re-run a job, close an issue or file a new issue, so options A and C would produce nothing it can deliver. The 504 on this download keeps coming back. The comments in `.github/workflows/ci.yml:310-317` already record it in CI runs 35615284953 and 42465389350, and run 42470227946 is the third. The triage itself names caching as the fix if the 504s recur. Option B leaves the pinned version, the 5×15s / `--retry-max-time 300` retry window (locked by `tests/test_ci_actionlint_install_retry.py`) and the sha256 check unchanged. It only makes most runs skip the download.

Binding constraints for the planner and implementer:
- Cache the downloaded tarball, not the extracted binary, in the `static-checks` job of `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, using `actions/cache@v5`. That is the major-version pin already used at `.github/workflows/plan.yml:129` and in `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml`.
- Key the cache on `ACTIONLINT_VERSION` and `ACTIONLINT_SHA256`, which are currently set on the step at lines 299-300. Move them to job-level or step-level `env:` so the cache step can read them, and keep their names and values unchanged (§10).
- Run `sha256sum -c` on every run, on a cache hit as well as a miss, so a poisoned or corrupt cache entry fails closed.
- Run the existing `curl` command only on a cache miss, and keep its flags exactly as they are now.
- Do not delete the tarball when the cache will save it. The current `rm -f "${tarball}"` at line 324 has to stay off the cached path, or the cache stays empty.
- Add a contract test, for example `tests/test_ci_actionlint_cache.py`, and wire it into the CI test list next to `tests/test_ci_actionlint_install_retry.py` (`ci.yml:2792`). The test should check:
  - the cache step exists, uses `actions/cache@v5`, and has a key containing both `ACTIONLINT_VERSION` and `ACTIONLINT_SHA256`;
  - the checksum check is not gated on a cache miss;
  - the retry flags are unchanged.
- Keep `tests/test_ci_actionlint_install_retry.py` passing without loosening it.

Base-branch caveat: the local checkout already has the retry change from PR #9055 (`ci.yml:318`). If the implement branch differs, apply the change on top of whatever `ci.yml` the pull request targets, and do not reintroduce the old 1s/2s/4s backoff.

The failed run of PR #9055 still needs a re-run once release downloads respond again. This pull request only reduces how often the problem happens. The pull request body must use `Refs #9053` (not `Fixes`) for #9053, because it is part of the `orchestrator/project-9033` chain (§21).
